credits.title: Crossroads
credits.overview: Two teenage brothers from a struggling home take a risky job for the local mafia to earn money for their mother, but the job quickly spirals into a dangerous test of loyalty, fear, and survival in a world of betrayal and shifting power.

credits.title: Greek Tragedy
credits.overview: With ten minutes to curtain, a young stage manager attempts to wrangle backstage chaos in order to put on a successful amateur theatre production.

credits.title: Marigold
credits.overview: When his wife vanishes from his life, a grieving young man turns to a mysterious stranger who guides him to confront the truth.

credits.title: New Balls Please
credits.overview: On the day of the junior tennis club championships, Detective Hawkeye touches down on the dark orange sands to investigate why players have collapsed dead.

credits.title: Dead Net
credits.overview: A promising young tennis player finds her dreams threatened when she is targeted by a mysterious figure who is out for her blood.

credits.title: Balls Up
credits.overview: Two marketing executives go "balls out" and pitch a bold full‑coverage condom sponsorship with the World Cup. After their drunken celebration in Brazil sparks a global scandal, they must outrun furious fans, criminals, and power-hungry officials to salvage their careers and make it home alive.

credits.title: Dolls of Mount Mary
credits.overview: At an isolated Catholic boarding school, an intelligent student uncovers the secret of a new textiles teacher using sinister methods to control the minds of those around him, this pushes her into a disturbing fight for her freedom and survival.
